definitions.correct_within_target: target job completed, majority answer verified correct, and job latency (scheduled arrival to last sample) within the target; every scheduled job is in the denominator
definitions.per_gpu_s: correct-within-target jobs divided by the GPU seconds attributed to target jobs: cell wall time (one GPU) times the job share of all tokens generated in the cell; prompt processing is not attributed separately
definitions.goodput_per_gpu_s: per cell: (target jobs correct within target + background requests completed within target) / cell wall seconds
definitions.ci95: percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of questions with replacement; seeds of a question are kept together; paired differences resample the same questions for both actions

caveat: one machine; fixed actions only, no router; intervals reflect question sampling and seed-level noise only as far as the seeds run
